title: IN-BAG | Balenciaga Unveils Three New Fragrances in Its «Extraits de Parfum» Line: Gender-Neutral Scents
original_title: IN-BAG | Balenciaga 发布3款「Extraits de Parfum」系列香水新作：中性香氛
excerpt: Balenciaga launches Extraits de Parfum, a three-scent collection of vanilla, amber, and oud in coffee-brown bottles inspired by its 1947 Le Dix, with an androgynous appeal.
author: 撰稿 X LING 编辑 X VIVI

blocks.text: Balenciaga has just unveiled its new «Extraits de Parfum» fragrance collection, built around three traditional ingredients—vanilla, amber, and oud—to create rich, multi-layered scents with plenty of tension. The bottles reinterpret the silhouette of the brand's first fragrance, «Le Dix», launched in 1947, in a deep coffee-brown tone; both bottle and scent exude an androgynous appeal.

The «Extraits de Parfum» bottle is a replica of the original Le Dix flacon held in the brand's archives, rendered in a deep coffee-brown hue that reveals a captivating, classical new sensuality. The bottle features a rounded spherical glass cap, and the neck is hand-tied with a black woven ribbon—a nod to the house's haute couture heritage.

«Vanilla XXL» is like a giant dessert masterpiece inspired by Balenciaga's signature haute couture silhouettes, delivering an intense Black Vanilla Elixir interwoven with musk and cinnamon. Mysterious and seductive, this fragrance makes a stunning entrance—like a magnificent silk gown confidently swirling onto the stage, leaving a trail of raw, addictive intensity.
Key notes: vanilla, boozy, musk, cinnamon, warm spice, sweet.

«Amber Crush» captures the tension between ancient ingredients, sealed in time-stopping, sense-amplifying amber. This fragrance intensifies the lushness of juicy plum, adds dimension with mysterious sandalwood, and weaves in warm, resinous incense for a crystalline brilliance. Precious spices and amplified materials unfold in layers, leaving a deep, lingering, and refined trail.
Key notes: amber, fruity, warm spice, boozy, sweet, balsamic, woody.

«Pink Oud» elegantly marries opulent Damask rose with rare Assafi oud, interpreting contemporary elegance. The rose lends extraordinary floral tension and a couture-like sensory experience, while the raw oud reveals a deep, supple, and nuanced woodiness. Bright yet rich, Pink Oud leaves a modern, captivating, and intoxicating trail—a floral ode to fashion.
Key notes: woody, rose, warm spice, warm spice.

Balenciaga has created a special discovery set—a black leather-wrapped case adorned with a gold-stamped logo and gold trim. Open the case to reveal the three new Extraits fragrances. All products are made, sealed, and packaged in France.
